data.value:
Objective and controls: Place pieces to trap and convert your opponent's pieces in a straight line: horizontal, vertical, or diagonal. The player with the most pieces at the end wins; a 32–32 score is a draw.
Start: Dark pieces move first. The board begins with four pieces in the center: D4 and E5 light, D5 and E4 dark.
Time and turns: Each match uses its configured time per turn. If you have no valid moves, your turn is skipped. Accumulating three turns that expire because of inactivity causes an automatic loss.
End of game: The match ends when the board is full, neither player has a valid move, or a player loses by leaving or inactivity.
Conduct: Be respectful in chat. Insults or offensive language may result in penalties or being muted.
